bio: The atmosphere here is pleasingly laid-back and trendy – in summer, the lovely terrace in front of the building gives you that holiday feeling. Using the freshest ingredients, the kitchen team serves up pared-back, modern Mediterranean cuisine. Diners choose between the Chef's Choice set menu, a vegetarian set menu and à la carte dishes. Given the restaurant's name, it is no surprise that wine plays an important role. The friendly and adept waitstaff will gladly recommend a suitable pairing for any dish. The terrific wine list comprises over 250 (organic) labels – also available to take away. Tip: Book a wine tasting....
